summary: Phase 149O.20I -- Class-B Deployment Verifier / Model-A Environment-Lock Bounded Implementation: BOUNDED NON-AUTHORITATIVE IMPLEMENTATION. Initial inspection confirmed repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, pcae health/check/status-coherence/push-check/runtime-inspect/notify-status all as expected, 149O.20H confirmed completed/reconciled via pcae phase-report reconcile --phase-id 149O.20H (status: reconciled, mutation: none). Read docs/contracts/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md and docs/PHASE_149O_20H_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_VERIFIER_MODEL_A_ENVIRONMENT_LOCK_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md directly and in full, plus production reference source (hatp_bootstrap.py, repository_identity.py, hatp_mandatory_certification.py's frozen-file-set constants). Implemented exactly the three planned production modules: hatp_class_b_topology_verifier.py (HBDC-REQ-001..021 -- principal distinctness derived live from os.geteuid()/os.getgroups(), Protected Root ownership/mode/effective-ACL-group-access/full-ancestor-chain/symlink/hard-link checks, reusing hatp_bootstrap._reject_symlink and _default_production_trust_root() rather than reimplementing), hatp_environment_lock_verifier.py (HBDC-REQ-023/025..039 -- interpreter/venv lock, PYTHONPATH, user-site, sitecustomize/usercustomize, .pth files, sys.meta_path hooks, CWD/sys.path-order shadowing, 19-file module-origin containment, editable-install metadata, launcher, PATH-precedence-aware trusted-Git check), and hatp_class_b_conformance.py (aggregator: Model-A detection via the pcae distribution's direct_url.json editable flag, deployment-identity wrapper reusing resolve_canonical_deployment_root/read_repository_identity/deployment_binding_matches unmodified, fail-closed all-mandatory-checks aggregation rule, zero self-certification). All three modules are strictly read-only (verified by AST self-check scanning for mkdir/chmod/chown/unlink/rename/write_text/write_bytes and by fixture stat-snapshot equality tests), fail closed on any unexpected exception/unsupported platform/unavailable ACL tooling (never a silent COMPLIANT), and accept zero caller-supplied authority booleans (verified by inspect.signature checks). Confirmed by repository-wide search that zero src/pcae/** files outside the three-module island import or reference the three new module names, and that hatp_mandatory_cutover.py/hatp_mandatory_certification.py/hatp_bootstrap.py/repository_identity.py/scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py remain byte-unchanged (git status --porcelain empty for each). Wrote 98 new tests across three files (37 topology + 31 environment-lock + 30 conformance), all passing on first stable run after two self-caught-and-fixed defects: a sys.meta_path class-vs-instance identity bug (the stdlib's own BuiltinImporter/FrozenImporter/PathFinder are registered as classes-used-directly, not instances; an initial type(finder).__name__ computation returned the metaclass name 'type' for these, causing a false NON_COMPLIANT against the safe baseline -- fixed to resolve the entry's own identity in either registration style) and an overly broad HBDC-REQ-004 os.environ-reference AST self-check that initially false-flagged this module's own legitimate PATH read inside _resolve_trusted_executable (needed for HBDC-REQ-038's Git-trust check) -- narrowed to flag only suspicious admin/user/identity-keyed environ reads and getuser/getlogin calls, not every os.environ reference. Ran the repository-standard Fast Green suite three times: (1) with-changes raw run, 83 failed/6644 passed/4 skipped/1 collection error; (2) a freshly-reproduced clean pre-phase baseline (the six new phase files temporarily moved out of the working tree to confirm a genuinely clean git status, then restored byte-identical) that exactly reproduced 149O.20H's own documented baseline: 59 failed/6570 passed/4 skipped/1 pre-existing fido2 collection error; (3) diffed the with-changes failed-test-ID set against this freshly-reproduced baseline (not the historical count alone), isolating exactly 26 candidate new failures. All 26 were individually traced to one of four disclosed, fully-explained categories: 9 pre-149O.20I 'no src/pcae file dirty in the working tree' self-checks (from 149O.14/1G/20A/20B/20C/20D/20D.1/20E/20H) tripped by this phase's own new untracked files, each confirmed to re-pass cleanly once committed; 5 parametrized cases of 149O.20C's 'no environment-lock implementation yet' test, correctly and intentionally superseded by this phase's authorized implementation (the intended outcome of this phase, not a regression); 1 unavoidable false positive from 149O.19.5E.2/149O.19.5E.3's blunt substring-scan test matching the legitimate, load-bearing 'core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py' string-data literal inside HBDC-REQ-034's 19-file authority-module list (a companion, non-load-bearing docstring reference to the same substring was removed as cleanup, reducing this from two files to one; removing the data-literal entry itself would silently drop HBDC-REQ-034 coverage for that file, which was rejected as an unacceptable trade); and 10 test_backend_cli.py failures independently reproduced as pre-existing parallel-execution flakiness completely unrelated to this phase's changes (confirmed by an isolated, serial re-run of that file alone with all three new modules present: 307/307 passed clean). Zero unexplained regressions. Ran a broad pytest -k 'class_b or hbdc or hmic or 149o_20' sweep (1042 passed, 47 failed, 4 skipped, 1 collection error) and confirmed its 15 net-new-vs-baseline failures are an exact subset of the same four disclosed categories. Ran governance close checks (pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect/notify status) -- all as expected; created a governed task with the full allowed-file set before committing (pcae health initially flagged the pre-task-creation working tree as unhealthy, resolved by pcae task new + pcae task update with every allowed-file flag in one call, per this repository's own established convention). Updated PROJECT_STATUS.md (demoting 149O.20H to a new 'Previous Phase' stacked entry) and CHANGELOG.md. Wrote docs/PHASE_149O_20I_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_VERIFIER_MODEL_A_ENVIRONMENT_LOCK_BOUNDED_IMPLEMENTATION.md documenting plan traceability, the file allowlist, the non-authoritative wall, the result/status model, every check category, the read-only guarantee, zero-authority-callers verification, all findings (including the two self-caught defects and the four disclosed pre-existing-test categories), the 98-test suite, and the implementation verdict. Committed all ten changed/new files in a single commit (99f833de). Verdict: CLASS-B DEPLOYMENT VERIFIER / MODEL-A ENVIRONMENT-LOCK: IMPLEMENTED IN NON-AUTHORITATIVE MODE -- READ-ONLY -- FAIL-CLOSED -- ZERO PRODUCTION AUTHORITY CONSUMERS -- SOURCE NOT YET HMIC-BOUND -- POSITIVE CONSUMPTION FORBIDDEN. Class-B remains CONTRACT VERIFIED -- VERIFIER IMPLEMENTED NON-AUTHORITATIVELY -- NOT PROVISIONED. CBV-S1: non-authoritative implementation complete, HMIC source-scope binding pending, NOT CLOSED. CBV-S10: readiness integration contract gap remains, NOT CLOSED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. This phase does not authorize real provisioning, certification, activation, HMIC scope evolution, or readiness integration. Recommended next phase: Phase 149O.20J -- Class-B Deployment Verifier / Model-A Environment-Lock Independent Implementation Verification -- not authorized by this phase.
